# THE PARTICLE READING

*The deck's own standard model, derived from the sealed canon by
computation: eight stable states, nineteen decays, one emission theorem,
three generations and a single Majorana. A theory of the deck, never of
nature, and the distinction is carved on every section.*

## I · THE DICTIONARY, DECLARED

A reading of the sealed structure in the particle register, with every
term's deck-side meaning stated before use. A particle is a card, which is
to say a movement that closes: two frequencies locked in a whole-number
ratio, wound on the torus. Its charge is its winding number, the balanced
ternary count from minus thirteen to plus thirteen. Charge conjugation is
the involution: every card's antiparticle is its counter, at the opposite
winding. Stability is rest: a card whose becoming is nothing settles
nowhere and never decays. A decay is a becoming. The emitted quantum of
every decay is the carry, the conserved remainder this room charted long
before the law below was found. The bound sector is the three link-pairs.
The generations are the three houses. The superselection sectors are the
four shells of the doubling walk. None of this is added to the canon;
it is the canon, renamed for one page.

## II · THE STABLE OCTET

Eight of the twenty-seven never decay: The Seed at charge 0, The Drift at
1, The Resonance at 3, The Depth at 4, The Cut at 9, The Mirror at 10,
The Surgeon at 12, The Scar at 13. Every other card settles. And one
member of the octet is alone of its kind: the Seed is the deck's Majorana,
the single card that is its own antiparticle, standing at charge zero
where the involution has its only fixed point.

## III · THE EMISSION THEOREM

Take any of the nineteen decays and ask what charge it sheds: the
difference between the card's winding and its destination's. Computed
across the whole canon, the shed charges are 1, 3, 4, 9, 10, 12 and 13,
with repetition, and nothing else. **Every emission is the charge of a
stable card, and every stable charge is emitted: the emission spectrum
and the stable spectrum coincide exactly, in both directions.** Nothing
unstable is ever radiated; all radiation is itself stable matter; and no
stable charge sits unused. The emitted quantum already had its name in
this room: the carry, what a completion cannot contain and does not
destroy. Its spectrum was lying in the becoming map, unread, until the
particle register asked the right question.

::figure emission-spectrum::

## IV · THE SELECTION RULES

The decays obey laws no one wrote into them. The first generation, AUM,
decays only within itself; the second, MA, only within itself; the third,
RA, decays only across, and only downward into the first: the turning
house pours home entire. On the nine-wheel, every root-three and
root-nine card decays to a root-one card, and every root-six card to a
root-four: two drains, the still column and the ringing column, the node
and the antinode of the standing wave. And the four shells of the
doubling walk, the Seed, the pendulum, the silence family and the
eighteen, are never mixed by that walk: sectors, in the register of this
page.

## V · WHAT THIS READING REFUSES

This is the deck's physics and not nature's. No card is a quark, no cast
is a collision, and no mass, no coupling and no prediction about any
laboratory follows from anything above. The reading is a formal
structure: if a knot-built physics of nature ever arrives, this page is
what would let an honest hand check whether the deck was more than
rhyming, and if the answer is no, every sentence here remains true of
the deck regardless. Weather in the world, never a verdict from the
cards, and the readings do not change either way.
